meta.purpose: Curated generic care tasks seeded for UNTRACKED plants only (the 'אחר כך' path). Tracked plants get individualized tasks from photo analysis and are never seeded from this file.
meta.generated: Species auto-generated from the encyclopedia `plants` table (id + category + day_type_affinity) via category/day-type archetype templates. Review before shipping.
meta.keying: Match by speciesId first; fall back to Hebrew name in `match`. If nothing matches, use `generic`.

seeding_rules.cap: Seed at most 5 tasks per plant (first 5 by dayOffset).
seeding_rules.idempotency: Seed once per plant; guard on no existing source_action='starter_tasks' rows for that garden_plants_id.
seeding_rules.delete_on_conversion: On untracked->tracked, DELETE WHERE garden_plants_id = $1 AND source_action = 'starter_tasks'.

scheduling.lunar_agnostic: lunarSensitive=false: schedule at seed_date + dayOffset. No calendar lookup.
scheduling.lunar_sensitive: lunarSensitive=true (pruning/cut-harvest/thinning/deadheading): from seed_date + dayOffset, snap forward to next FAVORABLE biodynamic day. See STARTER_TASKS_FINDINGS.md section 6 (nodeActive, planting_score, score_colour).

meta.review_note: Auto-templated by category+day_type with a few name overrides (basil/dill->leaf-herb, chamomile->flower, orange->citrus, plum/apple/pomegranate/fig->deciduous). Spot-check species deserving bespoke care.
